predict_steps.prompt: Flood starts at the first land (0,2). After exploring that island fully, what area did you just measure?
If the next land cell you try is already in visited, what do you do?
accepted_answers: do not start a new flood
predict_steps.hint: Only unvisited land starts a new island measure.

viva.question: How do you compute the largest island area in linear time over the grid?
expected_points: each land cell is flooded at most once
the flood returns the count of cells in that component
a global maximum tracks the best count
water cells contribute zero and are skipped

viva.question: What is the area when there is no land?
expected_points: no flood starts from a land cell
empty grids and all-water grids share that result

viva.question: Why add one for the current cell plus the recursive neighbor areas?
expected_points: the current land cell belongs to the island
neighbors extend the same connected component
visited marks ensure each cell is counted once
the sum is exactly the component size
